reason: I do lose callbacks in winter, but paying almost 2,000 $ up front before I've seen it catch a single call for me is too much of a leap. My paper agenda and texts are messy, but they're free and I know them.
objection: 2,000 $ setup on top of 249 $ a month, for something I can't try first. If my customers hang up on a robot or it gets the address wrong, that money is gone.
would_change_my_mind: Drop or spread out the setup fee, or let me run it for a month in winter and only pay setup if it actually caught calls I would have missed.
